title: Data Operations Specialist
subtitle: As a Data Operations Specialist at our dynamic eCommerce company, you will be at the heart of our technological infrastructure.
body:
As a Data Operations Specialist at our dynamic eCommerce company, you will be at the heart of our technological infrastructure. This role is ideal for someone with a background as a data engineer and a strong passion for technology, eager to work with a variety of tech stacks including Larksuite, Ads Platforms (Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, etc.), Shopify, and Amazon. You will work closely with the CEO to optimize data across all platforms and redesign workflows for efficiency and automation.

## Essential Roles and Responsibilities

- Optimize and manage data across various platforms, ensuring efficiency and accuracy.

- Work directly with the CEO to redesign workflows, implement automation, and improve overall operational efficiency.

- Actively engage with multiple tech stacks such as n8n, AnyCross, Larksuite, Ads Platforms, Shopify, Amazon, and TikTok Shop to enhance business operations.

- Collaborate with different departments to integrate and streamline technology solutions that support business goals.

- Stay abreast of the latest technological advancements and eCommerce trends to continually improve operations.

## Performance Goals

- Achieve measurable improvements in operational efficiency and data optimization.

- Successfully implement technological solutions that support the company's strategic goals.

- Foster a culture of continuous improvement and innovation within the data operations department.

## Skills and Qualifications

- At least 2 years of experience in data engineering or a related field, ideally in eCommerce or tech industries.

- Proficiency in working with various tech stacks such as Larksuite, Ads Platforms (Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, etc.), Shopify, and Amazon.

- Proven track record of improving processes and implementing successful tech solutions.

- Fluent in English with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- A commitment to physical fitness and a healthy lifestyle, can run at least 20km/week.

- Proactive learning behavior. We request all people to learn daily (only learn things that can support your work immediately) and share it with others.

- A positive, “can do” attitude.

- Understand our core values: 100%, Winning Mentality, and Teamwork. You can check it out here: patigroup.com. If you think this is something you have, give us proof.

## Salary and Benefits

- **Competitive Salary**: Negotiable salary ranging from 10 to 20 million VND per month, based on the candidate's abilities and experience.

- **Performance Bonuses**: Opportunity to receive a 13th-month salary bonus and annual revenue bonuses ranging from 1 to 2 months' salary.

- **Team Building and Internal Activities**: Participate in regular team building events and other internal activities to foster a sense of community and collaboration.

- **Comprehensive Insurance**: Full coverage for social, health, and unemployment insurance as per legal regulations, ensuring peace of mind.

- **Annual Leave**: Entitlement to 12 days of annual leave per year, allowing for rest and rejuvenation.

- **Company Welfare Policies**: Benefit from various company welfare policies designed to support and enrich the lives of employees.

- **Dynamic Working Environment**: Thrive in a professional and dynamic work environment that offers numerous opportunities for career advancement.

By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. We are looking for someone who shares our passion for wellness, our commitment to excellence, and our dedication to making a positive impact on our customers' lives. If you believe you have the skills and mindset to thrive in this role, we want to hear from you.

🚀 HOW TO APPLY

- CV & Portfolio (Highly recommended but not necessary) sent to email: assistant@patiagency.com

- If you are not have time to prepare CV, just show us what you have been doing. We are looking for builder who can do from 0 to 1 instead of 10 to 11

Company Address: 152 Dien Bien Phu Street, Ward 25, Binh Thanh District, Ho Chi Minh city
